sections.title: Life cycle and form
sections.text: Barley is a domesticated annual cereal, usually 0.5–1.3 m tall depending on cultivar and growing conditions.

sections.title: Spike and grain
sections.text: The leaves are linear; the dense terminal spike bears the grains, often with long awns. Some cultivars are awnless.

sections.title: Edibility
sections.text: Mature grains are edible and are used for food, malt and brewing.
